title: Instant Coffee, Decaffeinated, Pre‑lightened and Pre‑sweetened with Low‑Calorie Sweetener, Not Reconstituted

content.title: About
content.content: This is an instant, decaffeinated coffee that has already undergone a light roast and is sweetened with a low‑calorie sweetener. The product is ready to use without adding water – it can be dissolved in hot milk or used in cooking.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Instant coffee is made from roasted and ground beans from which caffeine is removed.
Pre‑lightening gives a milder taste without bitterness.
Low‑calorie sweeteners are usually based on stevia or erythritol.
The product is popular in diet nutrition and for people sensitive to caffeine.
Packaging is typically airtight to preserve aroma and freshness.

items.title: Low caffeine content
items.content: The absence of caffeine makes the drink safe for people with insomnia or heightened excitability.

items.title: Metabolism support
items.content: Some studies suggest that instant coffee may help boost metabolic rate.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Despite caffeine removal, the product retains polyphenols that combat free radicals.

items.title: Low calorie
items.content: The low‑calorie sweetener allows a sweet taste without extra calories.

items.title: Convenient
items.content: No additional preparation is needed – just add hot liquid.

items.title: Coffee allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to coffee components.

items.title: Sweetener intake
items.content: Excessive consumption of low‑calorie sweeteners can cause gastrointestinal discomfort.

items.title: Flavor loss
items.content: Aroma may diminish over time, so respect the expiration date.

items.title: Mineral content
items.content: Instant coffee contains fewer minerals than whole beans and should not replace them entirely.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Dissolve a serving in hot water, milk, or a plant‑based beverage. It can be added to smoothies, protein shakes, or used in baking as a sugar substitute.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place in a tightly sealed package. Keep moisture and direct sunlight away. Discard if you notice moldy odor or off‑flavor.
